en: A black‑and‑white postcard view over a small town in a valley, photographed from a country road lined with tall trees. In the middle distance are clustered houses and larger buildings, and on the right stands a church with a tower and spire. The surrounding landscape is hilly and wooded. At the top left there is red printed German text describing the view, and at the upper right a red handwritten number or notation.
